figurative_meaning_bn: পূর্বের মতোই অবস্থা; কোনো পরিবর্তন হয়নি
figurative_meaning_en: The situation remains the same as before; no change has occurred
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সমস্যাটি যথা পূর্ব তথা পর, কোনো সমাধান হয়নি।
তার আচরণ যথা পূর্ব তথা পর, একটুও পরিবর্তন নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: This problem is as before; no solution has been found.
His behavior is the same as ever; there's no change at all.
history: This idiom originates from Sanskrit literature, often used in classical texts to denote unchanging states.
note: The phrase is derived from ancient Sanskrit proverbs emphasizing permanence.
